_stamp: PD-37 recipe manifest -- @zakkster/lite-signal-decorators cookbook lane. gc: "gated" recipes hold the S1 budget (major 0, maxPauseMs 4.0, control-relative minors +128) and carry a COOKBOOK_BREAK sabotage control; steady-state loops additionally gate <= 0.589 B/op (the stamped noise floor), while construction-shaped loops (r1's churn) REPORT bytes/op as honest allocation-light-construction cost, never gated against the steady-state floor. gc: "none" REQUIRES a non-empty reason (an empty reason is a runner FAILURE). Authored 2026-08-30.
